.. _CDIF::DDSC::Classes::ComponentPosition:

ComponentPosition
*****************

.. index:: ComponentPosition

Fully qualified class name of the UML model CDIF-DDSC 1.0: **CDIF::DDSC::Classes::ComponentPosition**


Definition 
============ 
Indexes the components in a data structure using integers with a position indicated by incrementing upward from 0 or 1.
